detail.volume_probe_scope: Zero-diversion geometric probe only. Native5.1.1 uses seeded diverted rays and target/pair filtering; these are NOT actual native spring counts or a volume guarantee.

limitations: Nearest sampled vertex/triangle gaps and oriented face-normal signs, not signed solid/triangle/swept collision acceptance.
Cropped/open source collider may have seams, holes and ambiguous closest-face normals.
No rebake, contact-exclusion expansion or tolerance changes.
